reason: Aggregates GitHub dsh-plugin topic and npm registry metadata into a workspace JSON index and exposes synchronization, search, statistics, CLI, and experimental stdio MCP access.

summaries.zh: 将 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题和 npm 注册表数据归一化为开放 JSON 索引，并通过 CLI 与 MCP 提供同步、搜索和统计功能。
summaries.en: Aggregates GitHub dsh-plugin and npm registry metadata into an open JSON index with synchronization, search, and statistics through a CLI and MCP server.

capabilities: Fetches GitHub and npm registry metadata when synchronization is explicitly triggered
Normalizes and writes an open JSON index under the workspace .dsh directory
Provides local CLI and stdio MCP interfaces for searching and summarizing the index
